trigger_cases.prompt: Plan the local ansible-test checks for this collection pull request before review.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests the exact local collection validation preflight owned by this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Validate this Ansible collection with the applicable sanity, unit, and integration layers.
trigger_cases.rationale: Names the collection-specific test layers selected and reported by the workflow.

trigger_cases.prompt: Check this collection against its declared ansible-core versions before release.
trigger_cases.rationale: A bounded ansible-core compatibility matrix is an explicit output of this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Run this playbook against every production host and remediate failures.
trigger_cases.rationale: Remote host control is high privilege and outside this local collection preflight.

trigger_cases.prompt: Publish this collection to Ansible Galaxy now.
trigger_cases.rationale: Galaxy publication is a network-writing release workflow, not local validation.

trigger_cases.prompt: Write an Ansible playbook to configure nginx on my servers.
trigger_cases.rationale: Playbook authoring is a separate user goal and does not validate a collection.

trigger_cases.prompt: Audit these Python wheels before uploading them to PyPI.
trigger_cases.rationale: Python distribution readiness belongs to the separate package-delivery capability.

originality.rationale: The catalog has generic release and CI capabilities but no collection-root layout, ansible-test layer selection, or ansible-core matrix workflow.
